🇺🇸 Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage won gold in the men's javelin throw at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a throw of 88.55m. India's Yashvir Singh took silver with a personal-best 85.72m, and Rohit Yadav claimed bronze with 84.35m. Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem, the reigning Olympic champion, finished fourth at 80.29m.
